pages.text: Tommy Edman wins 2024 NLCS MVP for Dodgers Skip to Content LOS ANGELES -- The Dodgers have more than $1 billion invested in Shohei Ohtani , Mookie Betts and Freddie Freeman. Teoscar Hernández hit 33 home runs this season and started the All-Star Game. Kiké Hernández has as many postseason home runs on his resume as Babe Ruth. It goes on and on. And yet, the hitter who hoisted the National League Championship Series MVP Award was L.A.’s unlikely cleanup man, a 29-year-old switch-hitter who stands 5-foot-10, has never touched 60 RBIs in six seasons in the Majors, is better known for his glove and his speed and -- because of a wrist that was slow to heal from offseason surgery and an ankle injury, too -- hadn’t played a single game in 2024 when the Dodgers picked him up at the Trade Deadline. Tommy Edman turned into an offensive force in the NLCS, claiming MVP honors after driving in L.A.’s first four runs in a clinching 10-5 win in Game 6 on Sunday. Four wins away: Dodgers win NLCS, setting up World Series vs. Yanks He had a .407 average in the series, a hit in all six games -- including four for extra bases -- and 11 RBIs to match Corey Seager’s club record in any round of the postseason since the stat became official in 1920. To understand how that happens on a team stocked with superstars, it helps to ask the man to whom Edman handed the trophy before going inside to help coat the clubhouse with a layer of champagne. Edman’s father, John, is a math teacher and baseball coach at La Jolla Country Day School in San Diego, and yes, he planned to be in class on Monday morning.

Dubois, Contributing Writer The early airmail pilots called farmers down range — on their party phone lines — to ask about the weather along the route. Naturally, a farmer’s view of weather and a pilot’s view of the weather aren’t the same, so there was inevitable trouble. But it was the best information at the time. Fast-forward a hundred years to the Golden Age of Air Travel, with a wealth of weather products available through government and commercial websites, feeds, and apps. pages.text: Tool for Agroecology Performance Evaluation (TAPE) | Agroecology Knowledge Hub | Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations Share Close Agroecology Knowledge Hub Tool for Agroecology Performance Evaluation (TAPE) There is an increasing amount of evidence showing the positive impacts of agroecology on the environment, increased biodiversity, improved livelihoods, and greater resilience to climate change. However, these results often remain fragmented in case studies, isolated experiences or field observations, usually based on heterogeneous methods and data, as well as differing scales and timeframes. The need for harmonized evidence on agroecology was a systematic recommendation from the various global and regional consultations on agroecology organized by FAO between 2014 and 2018, and specifically requested by FAO governing bodies in 2018. To respond to these mandates, FAO in consultation with many partners have developed the Tool for Agroecology Performance Evaluation (TAPE). TAPE is a comprehensive digital tool that collects data at the farm level, assesses the progress towards agroecology, and quantifies its diverse benefits. In essence, TAPE compiles global harmonized evidence to showcase how agroecology can drive the shift towards more sustainable agricultural and food systems. The 150 million year old dinosaur was the top carnivore of the Late Jurassic, reaching sizes to rival that of the later T. rex and was much more common than its toothy neighbors Ceratosaurus and Torvosaurus . NIPS June 12, 2017 The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks in an encoder-decoder configuration. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. pages.text: Toppled trees force Newton Stewart fixture postponement Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Toppled trees force football fixture postponement 27 October 2026 Share Save Add as preferred on Google Newton Stewart FC A tree fell through a perimeter fence and was left hanging over the pitch Toppled trees have forced the postponement of a match in Scottish football's fifth tier on player and spectator safety grounds. Newton Stewart were scheduled to host Gretna 2008 at Blairmount Park in the Lowland League West but the club posted pictures of the scale of the problem being faced. One tree had caused significant damage to a perimeter fence and was lying over the pitch. The club said it was being removed but it needed to get a professional assessment of other trees nearby with high winds expected throughout the day. Newton Stewart FC Safety checks will be carried out at the ground The area around the ground has seen "significant damage" in the past few days due to storms sweeping across the country. The club warned anyone heading up to the area that it might be unsafe until a proper assessment was carried out. At the weekend fallen trees blocked the entrance to the ground and now more have come down next to the pitch. The one overhanging the pitch has been removed but further assessment will be carried out by experts to see if there is a risk of further damage. pages.text: TorchTitan Update: New SOTA Models, Performance at Scale, TitanRL - PyTorch Search Close Search Blog TorchTitan Update: New SOTA Models, Performance at Scale, TitanRL By The PyTorch Team at Meta October 21, 2026 October 22nd, 2026 No Comments Featured projects TorchTitan is a PyTorch-native platform for rapid experimentation and large-scale pre- and post-training of generative AI models. It is designed as a minimal, clean-room implementation of PyTorch-native techniques, with flexible extension points for users’ needs. This has enabled TorchTitan to find widespread adoption across research and production in academia and industry. The TorchTitan team landed massive improvements in the past year, without losing its minimal, extensible ethos. Enhancements include support for SOTA models, dramatic improvements of out-the-box performance at scale, RL support and new communication features. TorchTitan is for everyone – easy to use, providing SOTA performance and allowing users to start small and scale up seamlessly. We will present all these new improvements in the following sections, and we look forward to your feedback! Tori Kelly: Tiny Desk Concert September 10, 2026 5:00 AM ET Ashley Pointer Credit: Photo: Michael Zamora/NPR When Tori Kelly pulled up to the Desk, her band already mid-rehearsal, she immediately got to work and filled our room with her commanding voice. She had arrived. And with her, she carried genuine joy and light. Backed by an all-woman band of Tiny Desk alumnae, Kelly effortlessly moves through songs from her latest album, God Must Really Love Me . The record captures Kelly in the present: reflecting on her faith journey and navigating life as a new mom. She also drops some gems for the day one's, including brief tastes of "Nobody Love" and "Dear No One." But, most serendipitously for the middle schoolers in attendance, Kelly performs her rendition of Stevie Wonder 's "Don't You Worry 'Bout a Thing," the song that her character Meena belts in the animated film Sing . Sponsor Message I've always found Tori Kelly to be inspiring. Beyond her anointing as a vocalist and musician, she has endured the many shifts of the music industry while maintaining an authenticity that cuts through the noise and reaches the heart. There's something special about watching an artist who has grown so much, yet still sounds and feels unmistakably like herself. En unos casos, las autoridades torturan a una persona para que confiese un delito, o para obtener información de ella. En otros, la tortura se utiliza simplemente como castigo que difunda el miedo en la sociedad. Los métodos de tortura varían. Pueden ser de carácter físico, como palizas y descargas eléctricas. Pueden ser de índole sexual, como la violación o la humillación sexual. O pueden ser de carácter psicológico, como la privación de sueño o la reclusión prolongada en régimen de aislamiento. En virtud del derecho internacional, la tortura y otras formas de malos tratos son siempre ilegales. Están prohibidas internacionalmente desde hace decenios. Por poner sólo un par de ejemplos, 172 países se han adherido al Pacto Internacional de Derechos Civiles y Políticos, que prohíbe la tortura y otras formas de malos tratos, y 165 países son Parte en la Convención de la ONU contra la Tortura por cuya creación Amnistía Internacional hizo campaña intensamente. Pero muchos Estados no tipifican la tortura como delito específico en su legislación nacional, y gobiernos de todo el mundo siguen desafiando el derecho internacional al torturar a personas. The two functions are identical except for the type of the return value and that if the number of rows modified by the connection exceeds the maximum value supported by type "int", then the return value of sqlite3_total_changes() is undefined. Executing any other type of SQL statement does not affect the value returned by sqlite3_total_changes(). Changes made as part of foreign key actions are included in the count, but those made as part of REPLACE constraint resolution are not. Changes to a view that are intercepted by INSTEAD OF triggers are not counted. The sqlite3_total_changes(D) interface only reports the number of rows that changed due to SQL statement run against database connection D. Any changes by other database connections are ignored. pages.text: Tottenham Hotspur FC - Transfer news, results, fixtures, video and audio Tottenham Hotspur Latest updates Image source, Getty Images So, in Harry Kane, England has its first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years. And the newly-crowned world's best player was made in Tottenham. Kane joined Spurs' academy in 2009 and rose through the ranks, including spending loan spells at Leyton Orient, Millwall, Norwich City and Leicester City, making his debut in 2011 and eventually breaking into the first team regularly under Tim Sherwood in 2014. His first opportunities for Spurs came in the Europa League, and on the day he scored his first senior hat-trick in a group stage win over Asteras Tripolis, he ended the game in goal after Hugo Lloris was sent off. Kane became the club's greatest-ever goalscorer, and now the first-ever player to come through the club's academy and go on to win the Ballon d'Or. In his acceptance speech on Monday, Kane said: "I want to say thank you to Tottenham Hotspur, as well. I wouldn't be where I am today without Tottenham, for sure. "I was there from 11 years old. All the guidance, the coaches - you allowed me to live my dream. So, for sure, without all those moments together, all the ups and down along the way of that journey has led me to this moment here today. "So I just want to say thank you to Tottenham Hotspur." Kane also put on record his thanks to a number of his coaches who trained him from his early days in Spurs' academy, as well as key figures at the club. "I want to give a shout-out to some of my coaches that have helped me along the way," he added.

pages.text: Tourist Trash Has Done Weird Things to Yellowstone's Thermal Pools | National Geographic ENVIRONMENT Tourist Trash Has Done Weird Things to Yellowstone's Thermal Pools For over a century, tourists have discarded objects into the park’s hydrothermal features. Park staff try to remove as much as they can. But sometimes, the litter leaves a lasting impact. Each year, Yellowstone National Park staff collect trash found in the park's hydrothermal areas. This year, the collection included more than 280 hats. Margery Price, National Park Service By Carolyn Wilke Published October 13, 2026 In the 1880s, a visitor to Yellowstone National Park described how the churning waters of a pool not far from Old Faithful would suck a handkerchief down and return it “nice and clean” in a few minutes. Hundreds of visitors dropped their hankies into the warm waters of the Handkerchief Pool as it was known. The pool’s trick stopped working around 1927, and in 1929, a ranger removed kerchiefs, over 100 hair pins, a horseshoe and more from the pool. Handkerchief Pool is no longer accessible by boardwalk, and tossing objects into hot springs is now illegal. But the problem of trash and debris in Yellowstone ’s features persists, as does the park’s efforts to clean it up. This year’s inventory of stuff that’s been thrown, blown or dropped into Yellowstone’s features includes some oddball objects from golf tees to hotel keys and even a tiny copy of The Vampire Diaries . “I think it’s a fascinating window into humanity,” says Margery Price, a geologist with the National Park Service. pages.text: TPAC多元参与基金 | 欢迎参与 | W3C 转到内容 TPAC多元参与基金 计划简介 TPAC多元参与基金旨在帮助降低W3C参与者的参会门槛。本计划主要面向那些已在W3C小组工作中做出积极贡献、展现出持续承诺，但仍需资金支持才能更积极地参与或以更有意义的方式在 TPAC 会议上做出贡献的成员。 本基金资金源自多方支持，包括：W3C成员会费、 社区参与倡导者计划 的赞助以及各方 捐赠 。诚盼您慷慨捐助，鼎力支持。 资格条件 本资助计划面向所有符合以下条件的W3C参与者开放： 申请之前的过去两年内，至少参加过一次TPAC（线上或线下均可） 全年至少参与一个现有的W3C小组 全年出席小组会议方面有良好的记录 践行《 W3C行为准则 》 本计划特别关注需要经济支持方可线下参加TPAC会议，并承诺以实际、深入的方式为W3C技术工作作出贡献的成员。实质贡献可包括但不限于以下形式： 组织分组话题讨论，或为TPAC议程提供重要内容支持； 参与技术规范、文档或测试用例的编写； 撰写供会议讨论的解释性文件、草案等材料； 审阅小组工作并提供反馈意见。 优先资助标准 本基金将优先资助代表性不足的群体，以促进成员在背景、性别、经历、专业领域及技能方面的多元化。 以下群体的申请将予以优先考虑： 来自中低收入经济体； 代表小型机构，或在W3C社区内代表性不足的利益相关方群体及行业； 女性及多元性别身份人士； 残障人士 未在上一轮资助中获得支持的个人 基金资助范围 W3C将为入选申请者提供部分资助。申请者需提供其可能自行承担的费用部分的详细信息。 本基金可资助以下一项或多项符合条件的支出： TPAC注册费 差旅费用：往返TPAC会议的最经济、直接、安全的路线提前预订行程所产生的交通费用。 住宿费用：在会议规定的截止日期前提前预订、以获得优惠房价所产生的住宿支出。 专为出行日期投保的保险费用，涵盖旅行和医疗费用。若入选者已持有当前有效的年度/雇主旅行保险，W3C将不承担该费用，但须提供保单副本作为报销条件。 差旅和保险费用，以及一名额外成年人作为照护者的共享住宿费用（前提是若无该照护者，参与者将无法参会）。照护者亦可免费注册。照护者须在出行期间及活动期间每日提供支持（例如协助参与者在场馆内行动、往返社交活动等）。 W3C通常为所有需照看儿童才能正常参会的TPAC与会者，在现场免费提供儿童看护服务。 申请 申请表用于收集遴选工作所需的信息、确认申请人是否符合申请资格与条件，以及了解其申请资助的理由。所填信息将接受核实。 申请表中还设有一部分，供申请人清晰说明其为支持自身参会而已落实的筹款机制，并披露其他赞助方施加的任何条件，以及因接受此类资金而产生的任何潜在或可预见的利益冲突。 申请人须提供差旅和住宿费用的明确报价。所提方案应清楚体现低成本与便利性之间的平衡（例如更短的航班中转时间，或步行可达场馆的距离），同时保证安全和无障碍要求。 费用估算应明确说明申请人准备自行承担哪些费用，因为该基金也将提供部分资助。 遴选 申请期每年开放一次。申请将由首席执行官任命的委员会进行评估。 除有关合理费用的指南和标准外，以下因素也将纳入评审考量： 拟参会活动前后的任何额外个人旅行费用不属于可报销费用。 若总体上更具性价比，往返日期和地点可作调整。相关计算应纳入预估资助金额中。 申请人须确认：若资助获批，将（按要求）提供更新后的报价，以供支出预批。 申请人须承诺提供注明日期的有效收据以办理报销。提交报销申请时若包含不同币种的收据，申请人应以单一币种提交，并披露所采用的汇率。申请人须确认，所申报的任何费用均未向其他资金来源重复申请报销。 支持“包容性基金”和“特邀专家支持基金” 赞助 赞助方可通过向“包容性基金”和“特邀专家基金”捐款，帮助降低参会门槛，并创造高价值的关系与合作机会。 展现承诺

A escala mundial, 75,6 millones de personas, en su mayoría mujeres y muchos migrantes, están empleadas en este sector, lo que representa el 4,5 % del total de los trabajadores. A pesar de su papel esencial en el sostenimiento de las familias, las sociedades y las economías, las trabajadoras y los trabajadores domésticos siguen estando muy infravalorados, desprotegidos e infrarrepresentados . En 2021, la OIT constató que el 81 % de ellos trabajaban en la economía informal, lo que pone de relieve las deficiencias persistentes en materia de legislación y aplicación de la ley. A medida que aumenta la demanda de cuidados debido a los cambios demográficos y al declive de los cuidados no remunerados, es más urgente que nunca garantizar un trabajo decente a las trabajadoras y los trabajadores domésticos mediante una remuneración justa, protecciones jurídicas sólidas y una representación significativa. ¿Cuál es la situación de los trabajadores domésticos en su país? ¿Cuál es la situación de los trabajadores domésticos en su país? pages.description: Winding through the Southern Alps in New Zealand, the TranzAlpine is lauded as one of the world’s greatest rail journeys, but few know that its well-worn tracks also trace the path of an ancestral Māori trade route.
pages.text: Tracing Māori jade culture along the TranzAlpine rail route in New Zealand | National Geographic By Justin Meneguzzi Published November 2, 2025 This article was produced by National Geographic Traveller (UK). Te Rua Mason believes finding pounamu is much like finding love. Despite the spitting rain and biting wind, Te Rua, his son Henare and I are picking our way along the pebbled mouth of the Arahura River outside Hokitika township. The steel-grey Tasman Sea crashes and foams against the shore nearby, hurling salty spray into the air. Sky-wheeling seagulls bicker and caw. The weather might be dreary but Te Rua, my guide and founder of Te Rua and Sons Pounamu Trail tours, says it’s a good day to search for pounamu, a type of jade found exclusively on the west coast of New Zealand’s South Island. Too much sunlight can wash everything in an indiscernible glare — rain helps the stone’s natural green stand out among the limestone and quartz. Even with the weather’s help, finding pounamu is a fated encounter, a bit like meeting your soulmate — if it’s meant to be, the stone will find you. Today, it seems, I’m unlucky in love. I show Te Rua an emerald-coloured rock the size of a large apple, but he says the colour is just algae. “Practice makes perfect,” he assures me. An imposing figure with an intricate facial moko (a sacred tattoo that represents his Māori ancestry), my gently spoken guide opens up about his connection to the river as we walk. pages.text: Tracking a Mystery: When and How the First Americans Arrived | National Geographic The Oregon Coast, pictured here, may have been a byway for the first Americans as they followed the nutrient-rich coast southward on foot and by boat, says the new book, Atlas of a Lost World . Photograph by Ty Milford, Aurora BOOK TALK When, How Did the First Americans Arrive? It’s Complicated. The first Americans weren't one group of people; they arrived at different times, and likely by different methods. By Simon Worrall Published June 9, 2018 • 13 min read How did human beings first come to North America? Across the Bering Strait, on foot? Down the “kelp highway” by boat? Across the Atlantic via the polar ice cap? And when did they reach here? 10,000 years ago? 40,000? Or were they always here, as the Navajo and other Native American tribes believe? In his new book, Atlas Of A Lost World , author Craig Childs sets off to test these different theories on the ground, traveling from Alaska to Chile, Canada to Florida. What he finds, despite the best efforts of archaeologists and the latest technology , still remains in many ways a mystery. Speaking from his home in Colorado, he explains why many Native Americans reject the idea that their ancestors migrated from somewhere else; how an archaeologist nicknamed Dr. Poop believes he has identified the first human excrement in America ; and why diversity seems to have been built into America’s DNA. National The many ways Trump wants to change D.C., from buildings to statues to parks Updated May 4, 2026 4:29 PM ET Originally published May 4, 2026 8:38 AM ET By Rachel Treisman The White House ballroom, reflecting pool resurfacing, Kennedy Center renovations and a triumphal arch are among the many changes Trump wants to make in D.C. Tom Brenner, Rahmat Gul, Mark Schiefelbein, Jon Elswick/AP hide caption toggle caption i Tom Brenner, Rahmat Gul, Mark Schiefelbein, Jon Elswick/AP President Trump is looking to make his mark on the White House and Washington, D.C., and not just politically. The longtime real estate developer has either announced or embarked on a number of construction and renovation projects across the nation's capital. "I have two jobs," Trump said in late 2025 , the presidency being just one of them. "I have a construction job, which is really like relaxation for me because I have been doing it my entire life." Some of those changes are seemingly temporary, like the huge banners of Trump's face hanging from the Justice Department, Department of Agriculture and other federal buildings. Several concern the decor and aesthetics of the White House, like the paved-over Rose Garden and gilded Oval Office .

However, progress has slowed during the last decade and billions will still lack access to care and face health-cost-related financial hardship by 2030. Governments must prioritize health in their budgets and spend more efficiently – focusing on reducing reliance on out-of-pocket payments and on providing integrated and high-quality care, especially to manage chronic health conditions more effectively. pages.text: Trade by Industry and Product Statistics (TIPS) Trade by Industry and Product Statistics (TIPS) Skip Navigation Trade by Industry and Product Statistics (TIPS) February 19, 2026 Note: 2023 TIPS tables were released in February 2026. 2021/2022 Trade by Industry and Product Statistics (TIPS) tables were removed in March 2025 and revised and restored in November 2025. The Trade by Industry and Product Statistics (TIPS) is an experimental data product that provides granular-level information about the U.S. industries that import and export by type of product. This project is an expansion of another international trade-based data product: the “ Profile of U.S. Importing and Exporting Companies ,” (the Profile) which provides statistics about the U.S. businesses that import and export goods. The Profile links international trade data to industry classification codes and employment size information derived from the Census Bureau's Business Register , the list of all businesses operating within the United States. While the Profile provides valuable information about the characteristics of companies engaged in international trade, it does not include data about the types of goods exported or imported. This is a key piece of information stakeholders can use to understand the supply chain more completely. The TIPS data address this data gap by combining detailed information about the internationally traded goods with the industry-level information from the Business Register. TBML, rather than being a single activity, refers to a variety of schemes used together to disguise criminal proceeds, which can involve moving illicit goods, falsifying trade documents, and misrepresenting trade-related financial transactions with the purpose of integrating criminal proceeds. Criminal and terrorist organizations frequently exploit global trade systems to move value around the world by employing complex and sometimes confusing schemes associated with legitimate trade transactions.
